ui.keys: Use ← → to move, Esc to close

intro.title: Drive screen at a glance
body: Monitor and operate the conveyor drives, from the CHARGE POCKET to the DISCHARGE TABLE DRIVE.
Top: operation status, auto-run conditions, time settings / Middle: equipment drawing / Bottom: recent alarms and sensor lamps
Without control permission, 'View only' appears next to the title and buttons and inputs are locked.

opPanel.title: Charge / Discharge OP PANEL
body: Mode (MANUAL/AUTO) shows which way the selector on the field OP panel is set. It cannot be changed from this screen.
When AUTO RUN is lit, the line is running automatically.
When E-STOP lights red [[alarm]], an emergency stop is active.
The DISCHARGE OP PANEL works the same way.

alarmSw.title: ALARM SWITCH
body: ALARM RESET resets alarms; HORN STOP silences the alarm horn.
Hold the button for the hold delay (2 s by default) to activate it. A bar fills under the button while you hold.
The button lights green [[on]] while active and releases when you let go.
It works exactly like the same buttons on the Alarms screen.

cond.title: Charge / Discharge auto-run conditions
body: State of the conditions needed for auto run.
[[on]] Green: met   [[alarm]] Red: not met
If auto run will not start, check the red lamps first.

time.title: Discharge auto-run TIME settings
body: Tap a number to open the number pad; the value (seconds) is applied right away.
Input ranges — Product align (delay) TIME 0–600, Product detect clear TIME 0–600, SIDE CONVEYOR forward TIME 15–50
Values outside the range cannot be entered.

drivePanel.title: Drive control boxes
body: The CHARGE TABLE DRIVE, MAIN/CC DRIVE and DISCHARGE TABLE DRIVE boxes all work the same way.
ON/OFF: hold for the hold delay (2 s by default) to start or stop. A bar fills under the button while you hold.
While running, ON lights green [[on]]; when stopped, OFF lights red [[alarm]].
PV is the current speed; SV is the speed setting. Tap SV to open the number pad (charge and MAIN/CC 0–2610, discharge 0–4110 mm/Min).
DRIVE DETECT NORMAL: green [[on]] means normal, red [[alarm]] means abnormal.

zones.title: MAIN DRIVE zone 1–7 temperatures
body: PV is each zone's current temperature; SV is the set temperature.
Tap SV to open the number pad (0–1000℃). These are the same values as on the Temp Control screen.

facilityOff.title: Equipment OFF temperature
body: The red number is the temperature at which the equipment is switched off.
Each time you hold the OFF button for the hold delay it toggles on/off, and it stays that way after you let go.
Green [[on]] means on; red [[alarm]] means off.

stage.title: Equipment drawing
body: The drawing changes with the equipment state.
Motors: green when running, grey when stopped · Rollers and rails: roll while running · Circulation fans: spin while running
SIDE CONVEYOR arrows: shown only while rising or lowering · DOOR: green [[on]] / red [[alarm]] shows the door state · MAIN zones: orange while active
The rotation detect lamps under the motors and the product detect lamp light green [[on]] when detected.

alarms.title: Recent alarms
body: Shows the latest 100 alarms.
Status 'Active' [[alarm]] means the alarm has not cleared yet; 'Cleared' means it is over.
To search by period or download to Excel, use the Alarm History screen.

boards.title: Sensor and valve lamps
body: Charge/discharge SOL VALVEs, limit switches (L/S), proximity sensors (P/X) and product detection.
[[on]] Green: on / detected   [[alarm]] Red: off

end.title: Good to know
body: The hold delay can be changed on the Engineering screen and applies to every hold button.
You can reopen this guide any time with the ? button at the top right.

intro.title: Combustion screen at a glance
body: Operate the gas, combustion blower and burners, and watch zone 1–7 temperatures and burner state.
Top: equipment drawing (MAIN GAS, COMBUSTION BLOWER, BURNER COOL, zone temperatures and openings) / Middle: per-zone burn controls / Bottom: recent alarms and alarm/PURGE panels
Without control permission, 'View only' appears next to the title and buttons and inputs are locked.

mainGas.title: MAIN GAS
body: Opens and closes the MAIN GAS valve.
Hold OPEN/CLOSE for the hold delay (2 s by default) to operate it. A bar fills under the button while you hold.
When open, OPEN lights green [[on]]; when closed, CLOSE lights red [[alarm]].

pipeLamps.title: Pipe status lamps
body: Status lamps under the pipe fittings: MAIN GAS PRESS NORMAL and SOL SHUT, and COMBUSTION BLOWER PRESS ABNORMAL.
They show the state in green [[on]] / red [[alarm]].

blower.title: COMBUSTION BLOWER
body: Starts and stops the combustion blower.
Hold ON/OFF for the hold delay to operate it.
While running, ON lights green [[on]]; when stopped, OFF lights red [[alarm]].

burnerCool.title: BURNER COOL
body: Turns burner cooling on and off. Hold ON/OFF for the hold delay to operate it.
When on, ON lights green [[on]]; when off, OFF lights red [[alarm]].

zones.title: Zone 1–7 temperatures
body: PV is each zone's current temperature; SV is the set temperature.
Tap SV to open the number pad (0–1000℃). These are the same values as on the Temp Control and Drive screens.

per.title: Zone opening (%)
body: The % boxes above and below each zone show its burner opening (output). Both boxes show the same value.
It is the same value as the output (MV) on the Temp Control screen.

zoneBurn.title: Zone BURN ON/OFF
body: Turns burning on and off for a whole zone. Hold BURN ON/OFF for the hold delay to operate it.
While burning, ON lights green [[on]]; when stopped, OFF lights red [[alarm]].

zoneModal.title: Zone burners
body: Tap 'N ZONE BURNERS' to open the burner window for that zone.
In the window you can turn burners on and off one by one, or purge just that zone. The next pages open the zone 1 window to explain it.

zmBurners.title: Burner window — BURN ON/OFF
body: Each row is one burner. Burners 1 and 2 are on the left (L), 3 and 4 on the right (R).
Hold BURN ON/OFF for the hold delay to turn just that burner on or off.
While burning, BURN ON lights green [[on]]; when stopped, BURN OFF lights red [[alarm]].

zmPurge.title: Burner window — zone PURGE · close
body: Hold START PURGE for the hold delay to purge just this zone. It lights green [[on]] while purging.
Close the window with ✕ at the top right, Esc, or by tapping outside.

stage.title: Equipment drawing
body: The drawing changes with the equipment state.
The MAIN GAS valves and the combustion blower valve and fan keep their own colour when open/running and turn red [[alarm]] when closed/stopped.
The lightning marks behind the flames appear only while igniting.

alarms.title: Recent alarms
body: Shows the latest 100 alarms.
Status 'Active' [[alarm]] means the alarm has not cleared yet; 'Cleared' means it is over.
To search by period or download to Excel, use the Alarm History screen.

alarmReset.title: MISFIRE ALARM · BURNER ALARM
body: MISFIRE lights red [[alarm]] on a misfire, and ABNORMAL lights red [[alarm]] on a burner fault.
Hold RESET for the hold delay to reset that alarm. The RESET buttons are always yellow.

purge.title: ALL PURGE
body: Hold ON for the hold delay to start PURGE for all zones.
Progress lights up in order: PURGE READY (red [[alarm]]) → PURGING (yellow [[warn]]) → PURGE DONE (green [[on]]).

end.title: Good to know
body: The hold delay can be changed on the Engineering screen and applies to every hold button.
You can reopen this guide any time with the ? button at the top right.

intro.title: Temp Control screen at a glance
body: Monitor and set the temperature of zones 1–7, one panel per zone.
All seven panels are laid out the same way. This guide uses the 1ZONE panel.
Without control permission, 'View only' appears next to the title and buttons and inputs are locked.

panel.title: One zone panel
body: Top left: PV, SV and MV bar gauges with their values
Bottom left: AUTO/MANUAL mode button and Manual output (MV)
Right: alarm settings (HH, H, L, LL) and OUTPUT LIMIT

gauges.title: PV · SV · MV
body: PV (red) is the current temperature, SV (green) the set temperature, MV (blue) the output (%).
Tap SV to open the number pad (0–1000℃). It shows the setting in effect, which may move gradually toward your entry.
SV matches the Combustion and Drive screens; MV matches the zone opening (%) on the Combustion screen.

mode.title: AUTO · MANUAL
body: The button shows the current mode: AUTO in green [[on]], MANUAL in red [[alarm]].
In AUTO, the output (MV) is set automatically to reach the set temperature (SV).
Hold the button for the hold delay (2 s by default) to switch modes. A bar fills under the button while you hold.

manualMv.title: Manual output (MV)
body: Sets the output (%) directly in MANUAL mode. Tap the box to open the number pad (0–100%).
In AUTO mode the box is dimmed and locked.

alarm.title: Alarm settings HH · H · L · LL
body: HH, H, L and LL are the reference values for the high-high, high, low and low-low alarms.
Tap a box to open the number pad. Input ranges — HH 0–500, H 0–200, L 0–200, LL 0–400
Values outside the range cannot be entered.

limit.title: OUTPUT LIMIT (MV%)
body: Sets the range the output (MV) can move in. The output never goes below Low or above High.
Tap a box to open the number pad (High and Low both 0–100%).

end.title: Good to know
body: 2–7ZONE panels work exactly like 1ZONE. Each panel's values apply only to its own zone.
The hold delay can be changed on the Engineering screen and applies to every hold button.
You can reopen this guide any time with the ? button at the top right.

intro.title: Atmosphere screen at a glance
body: Monitor and operate the ADDITION BLOWER and GAS lines and the ADDITION CONTROL MOTOR VALVE.
Top left: ADDITION BLOWER/GAS / Center: control valve panel / Bottom left: auto-mode conditions / Right: generator, to furnace, O2 SENSOR
Without control permission, 'View only' appears next to the title and buttons and inputs are locked.

addition.title: ADDITION BLOWER · GAS
body: Hold OPEN/CLOSE for the hold delay (2 s by default) to operate it. A bar fills under the button while you hold.
When open, OPEN lights green [[on]]; when closed, CLOSE lights red [[alarm]].
It stays that way after you let go. To change it, hold the other button.

pipeLamps.title: PRESS ABNORMAL · SOL SHUT
body: Status lamps under the pressure control valves and solenoid valves.
They show the state in green [[on]] / red [[alarm]].

fittings.title: Equipment drawing
body: The drawing changes with the equipment state.
Blower, pressure control valves, solenoid valves: green [[on]] when operating, grey [[off]] otherwise
Control valve on the main pipe: spins while operating · Beacon above the generator: shows the state in green [[on]] / red [[alarm]].

valveValues.title: Control valve — PV · SV · MV
body: PV (red) is the current value; MV (orange) is the output (%).
SV (green) is the set value. Tap it to open the number pad (0–1200 mmV).

pid.title: Control valve — P · I · D
body: Control settings that decide the output in AUTO. P is the proportional band, I the integral time, D the derivative time.
Tap a box to open the number pad. Input ranges — P 0–1200, I 0–2400, D 0–600

refTemp.title: Allowed ref. temp
body: Tap the box to open the number pad (650–1000℃).
When the temperature reaches the allowed reference temperature, the lamp on the left lights green [[on]]. It is one of the auto-mode conditions.

mode.title: AUTO · MANUAL
body: The current mode lights green [[on]].
Hold the mode you want for the hold delay to switch to it; it stays after you let go.
In AUTO, the output (MV) is set automatically to reach the set value (SV).

manualMv.title: MANUAL MV (manual output)
body: Sets the output (%) directly in MANUAL mode. Tap the box to open the number pad (0–100%).
In AUTO mode the box is dimmed and locked.

cond.title: Auto-mode conditions
body: The seven conditions needed for atmosphere control to run in AUTO.
[[on]] Green: met   [[alarm]] Red: not met
If AUTO will not run, check the red lamps first.

gen.title: GENERATOR
body: When the generator GAS is open, OPEN lights green [[on]]; when closed, CLOSE lights red [[alarm]].
It cannot be opened or closed from this screen.

o2.title: O2 SENSOR
body: The O2 sensor value inside the furnace (mmV).

end.title: Good to know
body: The hold delay can be changed on the Engineering screen and applies to every hold button.
You can reopen this guide any time with the ? button at the top right.
